verses.text: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.

segments.text: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God.
They are corrupt, they have done abominable works;
There is none that doeth good.

verses.text: Jehovah looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.

segments.text: Jehovah looked down from heaven upon the children of men,
To see if there were any that did understand,
That did seek after God.

verses.text: They are all gone aside; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.

segments.text: They are all gone aside; they are together become filthy;
There is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.text: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And call not upon Jehovah?

segments.text: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge,
Who eat up my people
as
they eat bread,
And call not upon Jehovah?

verses.text: There were they in great fear; For God is in the generation of the righteous.

segments.text: There were they in great fear;
For God is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.text: Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor, Because Jehovah is his refuge.

segments.text: Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor,
Because Jehovah is his refuge.

verses.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

segments.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion!
When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people,
Then shall Jacob rejoice,
and
Israel shall be glad.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
